sources.title: Randal S. Olson · 2026 National Parks optimized driving-time loop
Published road geometry · OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL 1.0
National Park Service · all64 national parks

notes.en: Includes a published driving-time optimized loop through 52 lower-48 park gateways, all 64 NPS national park overview points, four official Amtrak route geometries, and three synthetic great-circle flights. The road loop is not a shortest-distance or all-64-parks itinerary; islands and the 12 parks outside the lower 48 need other transport. Rail source gaps remain separate segments. Flights are animation examples, not scheduled services or actual tracks.
notes.zh: 包含公开的美国本土48州52座国家公园门户驾车时间优化环线、全部64座国家公园概览点、4条官方Amtrak铁路几何，以及3段大圆飞行示例。公路环线不等于最短里程或全部64座公园的完整行程；岛屿及本土48州以外12座公园需其他交通方式。铁路源数据缺口保留为独立路段。飞行数据仅用于动画测试，并非真实航迹或直飞航班承诺。
